review.summary:
approve_with_nits. The config change is a single line and is consistent with the rest of the repo. pytest: 29 passed, and the link check is included. The decision row and CHANGELOG lines match the earlier PR40-F1 fix.
1. Question: is `gpt-6.2-sol` a valid model ID for Codex CLI 0.164.0 on a ChatGPT login? Public sources only document 6/6.1 Sol. If it isn't valid, every GPT review fails.
2. Question: the CHANGELOG says Astra's default context is under 400k, but public sources give 1.05M. Name the source, or say 'Codex default'.

findings.title: Is gpt-6.2-sol available through Codex CLI 0.164.0 on a ChatGPT login?
findings.claim: The GPT reviewer is now pinned to `gpt-6.2-sol`. The PR says live compatibility with CLI 0.164.0 is unverified. Public documentation I could find lists GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6.1 Sol but no official GPT-6.2 Sol release or Codex listing. If the ID is rejected, every automatic review and the monthly project review on this repo fails (they all default to `gpt`). There is also no reviewer fallback, because Claude-family reviewers are refused on Claude-built work.
findings.evidence: Search results: only third-party pages mention GPT-6.2 Sol (https://overchat.ai/models/gpt-6-2-sol, https://www.cometapi.com/gpt-6-2-sol-prediction/). Official docs list GPT-6 Sol (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-sol.md). Secondary reports say 6.1 Sol is the Codex default (https://techenclave.com/news/items/openai-releases-gpt-6-1-sol-for-codex-chatgpt-work-and-the-api). The PR description says: 'GPT-6.2 Sol's live compatibility with CLI 0.164.0 remains unverified.'
findings.proposed_change: Before marking the PR ready, confirm the ID with a single `/review force` run on a throwaway PR, or check `codex /model` output under the pinned CLI. Add the rollback to the CHANGELOG line ('Rollback: restore `gpt-6.1-sol`'), as the 17 Nov line does for the harness pin.

findings.title: Source for Astra's 'default context smaller than 400,000 tokens'
findings.claim: The CHANGELOG gives the reason Astra is not configured: its default context is smaller than the 400,000-token project pack cap. Public sources consistently give GPT-6 Astra a 1.05M-token context window. The claim may be about a Codex CLI default context setting rather than the model's window, but the line doesn't say so. Read as written, the reason looks wrong.
findings.evidence: https://codex.danielvaughan.com/2026/09/04/gpt-6-astra-codex-cli-integration-guide-critical-cyber-threshold/ ('1.05M Context'); https://docs.apiyi.com/en/api-capabilities/gpt-6-astra/overview.md. None of the sources I found states a smaller Codex default.
findings.proposed_change: If the limit is a Codex CLI default, say so: 'Codex CLI's default context for Astra is below the 400,000-token project pack cap'. Otherwise give the source or drop the context reason and keep 'live compatibility with the pinned CLI is unverified'.
